verdict.rationale: The evidence documents two separate things: gradual Scheduled Rollouts, and an emergency disable switch that is flipped manually. It also mentions Infra Analytics alerts that 'catch regressions', but that is an adjacent monitoring feature. Nothing ties those alerts to a rollout as a metric guardrail, and nothing shows a regression automatically rolling a release back, so this counts as adjacent support only.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically
